name: What is the process for hiring Frasheski Construction for backsplash installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for hiring Frasheski Construction for backsplash installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation, either over the phone or at your home in areas like Berkeley, Oakland, or El Cerrito, to discuss your vision, materials, and project scope. Following this, we provide a detailed, transparent estimate. Once approved, we schedule the installation at your convenience. Our team then prepares the area, installs the backsplash, and completes all finishing touches, ensuring a clean work environment. This First-Party Insight outlines our commitment to clear communication and a streamlined, professional experience from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, estimate, scheduling, installation, and finishing touches, ensuring clear communication throughout.
